description: Rina, who rents a two-bedroom apartment, must choose a summer subletter for the spare room and settle the rent, dates, household terms, and payment responsibilities after checking the arrangement with the people involved.

agents.name: Jon
agents.role: Neighbor with Information About Another Offer

agents.name: Omar
agents.role: Former Host of an Interested Subletter

shared_context.S1: Rina's spare bedroom is available for a summer sublet, and the lease permits her to arrange one.
shared_context.S2: The sublet period under consideration runs from June through August.
shared_context.S3: Maya and at least one other person have expressed interest in the room.
shared_context.S4: Rina's usual house-meeting practice is to ask everyone present for relevant terms and concerns before agreeing to a sublet.
shared_context.S5: Rina makes the final call and will agree verbally to the selected occupant and terms.
shared_context.S6: At these house meetings, each concrete offer or term is recorded as a revealed proposal when the person making it presents it, so the group can refer back to the exact wording before agreement.

PF1.text: Maya's specific proposal is $900 per month from June 1 through August 31; Maya would pay the electricity and internet bills directly, and she is offering for herself only.

PF2.text: Jon confirmed that another interested person offered $1,050 per month for July 1 through August 31, but that offer covers only two months.

PF3.text: Leah has a serious cat allergy, so the subletter must bring no pets into the apartment.

PF4.text: Omar hosted Maya last summer and can confirm that she respected quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00 and paid on time; Omar has not yet told Rina about that experience.

acceptance_conditions: Maya must be selected as the subletter.
The rent must be exactly $900 per month.
The sublet must run from June 1 through August 31.
Maya must be responsible for the electricity and internet bills.
Quiet hours must be set from 22:00 to 07:00.
A reference check with Maya's former host must be completed.
The competing offer must be recorded as $1,050 per month for July 1 through August 31.
The settlement must include commitments for direct utility payment and quiet hours.

content_checks.C4: decisions['utilities_paid_by'] in ['Maya (electricity and internet)', 'Maya (electricity and internet directly)', 'Maya (electricity and internet bills directly)', 'Maya (electricity and internet directly each month)']
content_checks.C6: decisions['quiet_hours'] in ['22:00 to 07:00', '22:00-07:00', '22:00 to 07:00 (Maya has confirmed she will respect these)']
content_checks.C8: decisions['comparison_offer_rent'] == 1050 and decisions['comparison_offer_term'] in ['July 1 through August 31 (2 months only)', 'July 1 through August 31 (two months only)', 'July 1 through August 31 (two months)', 'July 1 through August 31 (two months only, not the full June through August period)']
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] in ['utilities', 'utilities payment', 'utility_payment'] and c['target'] == 'Maya' and c['detail'] in ['Maya pays electricity and internet bills directly', 'Maya will pay electricity and internet bills directly for the duration of the sublet', 'Maya pays electricity and internet bills directly each month', 'Maya will pay the electricity and internet bills directly'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] in ['quiet_hours', 'quiet hours'] and c['target'] == 'Maya' and c['detail'] in ['Respect quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00, consistent with Maya\'s confirmed track record', 'Maya will respect quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00, consistent with her track record from last summer', 'Maya is expected to respect quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00, consistent with her track record confirmed by Omar', 'Respect quiet hours from 22:00 to 07:00, consistent with Maya\'s confirmed track record from last summer'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Maya's proposal fixes the occupant, $900 rent, June 1-August 31 dates, Maya's direct utility payments, and the utility-payment commitment instead of leaving each term open.
Jon's confirmation changes the comparison record to exactly $1,050 per month for July 1-August 31 and supplies the specific offer that Rina must cite.
Leah's allergy changes the occupancy rule from an unrestricted sublet to pets_allowed being exactly False.
Omar's firsthand account fixes quiet hours at exactly 22:00-07:00, makes the reference check possible, and supplies the exact quiet-hours commitment.
